title: Correction: cholesterol context of exercise angina with explicitly quantile-knotted baselines
abstract: A cholesterol-by-exercise-angina product did not establish incremental angiographic CAD prediction beyond flexible additive routine predictors: Cleveland cross-validated Brier gain -0.000656; independent-institution Hungarian gain -0.000800 (500 joint source-refit/target bootstrap 95% interval [-0.012180, 0.006754]). Source n=303;external n=261. One prespecified product was added to a ridge-logistic spline baseline. Neither the source nor external uncertainty criterion was met. Historical institutions offer retrospective external validation,not untouched prospective confirmation;the result does not establish equivalence or absence of useful physiological information.
